answer: The fee is charged through a vertex debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the voyage totals, and the knoll anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 40 units per epoch, sustaining 49 aliases for 34 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
